responsibility: Implements the MicroBlaze target’s C-family frontend hook for predefined preprocessor state. Its responsibility is to publish architecture, endianness, and hardware-feature macros and assertions—such as MicroBlaze CPU identity plus multiply, divide, barrel-shift, pattern-compare, and floating-point capabilities—based on the selected target flags, so front ends and user headers can condition compilation on the exact MicroBlaze configuration being compiled for.
